Name: Waves in Adagio
Description: You perform a drawn out melody, creating a wave of pure sound that washes over the ground in a slow movement. When you do this, you create a 15-ft. long and 10-ft. wide cone that moves 10-ft. in a direction you choose as part of casting this spell. This movement happens at the end of your turns, lasting for up to three turns and becoming 5-ft. wider yet losing 5-ft. of its length per turn, until it vanishes. Any creature who comes to share the same space as the wave must pass a Constitution saving throw or suffer 2d8 thunder damage and be knocked Prone, or only suffer half that damage on a success.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you deal an additional 1d8 thunder damage for each slot level above 2nd.
